cycling_rate_linkage.conclusion: long_cycle_capacity.tsv carries no rate label and no shared identifier with the rate files; no cross-link is testable

affine_family.conclusion: the rate family is not a single pure additive shift for the majority of high-R2 pairs, i.e. the polarization changes shape with rate; but the count is sensitive to the unstated tolerance and grid, and for several excluded pairs a pure offset also reaches R2 > 0.97

linkage_interpretation.alternative: the summary series may have been computed as a mid-SoC reduction of the same curves, in which case the agreement is definitional rather than an independent physical law
linkage_interpretation.discriminating_evidence: the single-SoC reduction (RMSE 0.1837 pp at SoC=50) is much tighter than an energy-weighted branch ratio computed over an explicit 2-96 % window (RMSE 2.8664 pp); the energy-weighted value is definition/window dependent (2.8-4.9 pp across defensible windows)
linkage_interpretation.permutation_test_is_non_evidential: the 5040-permutation identity rank of 1 is guaranteed by the rearrangement inequality whenever both series are monotone in the same direction, so it carries no evidence of shared construction; only the magnitude gap between the identity RMSE and the runner-up RMSE is informative
